about: Wyrmscraig (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Wyrmscraig), as captured: the open-access quest state, the cave under Ardeaglais, and the Mad Angel. See docs/wyrmscraig.md.

openAccess.about: Fallen From Grace isn't on this server: every player gets its finished state, which the cache's own multilocs read (the post-quest Mad Angel, the powered golem, the mined rocks at the top of the cliff shortcut).
